attributes.name: Flensing Jelly
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d6 and the Acid or Poison trait to a combat check by a character at your location.

Banish this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d4 and the Acid or Poison trait to your combat checks. You may succeed at a Craft 9 check; then discard a card that has the Alchemical trait to recharge this card instead of banishing it.
